fields_or_schema: participant_id; session_id; part_session_id; part_number; block_number; block_label; trial_number; trial_number_global; trial_uid; condition; phase; noise_type; trial_type; soa_ms; response_given; hit_miss; reaction_time_ms
evidence_role: Compact trial-level response summary for sharing, OSF-style data release, and quick pooled checks.
public_release_status: Candidate public data after deidentification and human release review.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Participant identifiers must remain pseudonymous; small-N combinations of participant code, block order, and dates can still be identifying if released with other metadata.

fields_or_schema: Same 17 fields as participant public CSV.
evidence_role: Pooled copy of completed/public participant rows for reuse and external analysis.
public_release_status: Candidate public data after deidentification and human release review.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Should include only approved completed/deidentified rows; it is not a raw acquisition archive.

fields_or_schema: recording_date; recording_time; recording_unix_time; participant_id; participant_age_years; participant_gender; participant_handedness; session_id; session_group_id; part_session_id; part_number; condition; block_number; block_label; trial_number; trial_uid; trial_type; family; respiratory_phase; row_label; stimulus_modality; noise_type; soa_ms; tactile_present; catch_trial; audio_present; stimulus_start_unix_time; tactile_unix_time; response_window_onset_unix_time; response_unix_time; rt_ms; response_event_id; response_given; outcome; correctness_rule; is_topup; topup_role; source_trial_uid; primary_analysis_included
evidence_role: Reconstructs trial timing, response classification, catch/top-up status, and analysis inclusion.
public_release_status: Private/session reconstruction layer unless deidentified and explicitly approved.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Contains demographic fields and fine-grained timestamps; do not publish by default.

fields_or_schema: pps-run-session.v1; pps-runner-session-metadata.v1; loudness policy payload; protocol schedule rows
evidence_role: Links participant run output to design, profile snapshot, block WAVs, loudness policy, route settings, source hashes, and capture options.
public_release_status: Archive with validation package; public only after path/privacy review.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: May contain local paths, participant metadata, hardware route details, and private profile copies.

fields_or_schema: Block CSV fields include trial UID, trial type, family, SOA, source file path/hash, sample rate, channels, tactile/looming onsets, response window, and trial-end samples.
evidence_role: Shows exactly what the runner was prepared to play and when events were scheduled in sample coordinates.
public_release_status: Validation/archive layer; public only if stimuli and paths are redistributable.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: WAVs can include generated or imported stimuli; rights and local-path review are required before sharing.

evidence_role: Auditable software event stream for trial starts, onsets, clicks, pauses, top-up, calibration, and adaptive-threshold events.
public_release_status: Private/session reconstruction layer; selected summaries can be shared after deidentification.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Payloads may contain local paths, participant ids, setup settings, or operator notes.

artifact_or_folder: LSL marker mirror, trigger dictionary, and XDF files
fields_or_schema: LSL CSV fields include event id/type/code, trigger key, marker name, session/participant/part ids, lsl timestamp quality, sample index, block index, trial uid, pushed_to_lsl, and payload JSON.
evidence_role: Reconciles runner events with LSL marker pushes and optional LabRecorder capture.
public_release_status: Validation/archive layer; not a public participant table by default.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: LSL/XDF evidence is still route-specific and does not by itself prove physical audio/tactile onset.

fields_or_schema: pps-tactile-calibration.v2; two_down_one_up_detection_threshold.v2; trial fields include phase, level, staircase state, catch flags, response timing, outcome, and recenter metadata.
evidence_role: Documents participant-specific tactile threshold procedure and accepted preset.
public_release_status: Private/perceptual calibration artifact; publish only as deidentified summary unless approved.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: A perceptual detection preset is not mechanical actuator-onset evidence.

artifact_or_folder: Top-up ledger and materialized top-up blocks
fields_or_schema: pps-topup-ledger.v1 plus dynamic rows for tactile hit/miss/top-up status and source trial provenance.
evidence_role: Tracks original misses, hit status, top-up attempts, and source-trial mapping without erasing primary rows.
public_release_status: Private/session reconstruction layer unless summarized and deidentified.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Top-up completion does not convert an original miss into an original hit.

fields_or_schema: Adjustment CSV fields: schema; adjustment_index; old/new/increment Output 3/4 percent; triggering miss count; triggering ledger id; triggering trial uid; triggering block/trial; triggering is_topup; triggering miss reason.
evidence_role: Records the run-local two-miss Output 3/4 nudge safeguard.
public_release_status: Private/session reconstruction layer; publish only as deidentified validation summary unless approved.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Documents a safeguard, not a validated correction for habituation or condition-dependent misses.

path_pattern: Data_Analytics/<session_id>/; analysis_catalog.json; model-fit tables; response summaries; timing_qc.csv
fields_or_schema: Analysis CSVs are dynamically keyed by available summaries; timing_qc fields include mouse/marker event ids, unix/monotonic times, marker-minus-mouse delay, clock, channel, gain, and block labels.
evidence_role: Provides operator QC, response integrity checks, baseline summaries, exploratory model fits, and artifact pointers.
public_release_status: Exploratory review layer; share only selected deidentified summaries unless preregistered analysis is supplied.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Instant analysis is not confirmatory inference and should not be treated as the paper's effect estimate.

evidence_role: Preserves participant metadata needed for local reconstruction and session administration.
public_release_status: Private by default; exclude from public code/materials/data release unless deidentified and approved.
privacy_or_rights_caveat: Contains participant metadata and may be identifying.
